description: Chips are selectable, pill-shaped toggles built on a hidden checkbox/radio input. The visible pill is the `custom-chip-label`; the real form control is the visually-hidden `custom-chip-input` sibling. When the input is checked the label fills in (default gray, or a theme color when a `chip-{color}` modifier is on the wrapper). Chips are exos-CUSTOM — not Bootstrap badges/pills.

always: Wrap the input and label together inside a single `custom-chip` element.
The `custom-chip-input` must be a real <input> (type=checkbox or radio) and must precede the `custom-chip-label` so the CSS sibling selector (~) can style the checked/focus/disabled states.
Associate the input and label with a shared id/for so the whole pill is clickable.
Apply the optional `chip-{color}` modifier to the `custom-chip` wrapper, never to the label.
never: Do not hide the input with display:none — the theme positions it off-screen so it stays focusable and accessible.
Do not use a CSS class for the disabled state — set the `disabled` attribute on the `custom-chip-input`.
Do not put the color modifier on the label or input.

a11y: The control is the hidden `custom-chip-input`; keep it in the DOM (off-screen, not display:none) so it remains keyboard-focusable.
Use radio inputs (shared name) for single-select chip groups and checkbox inputs for multi-select.
Decorative icon glyphs inside the label should be marked aria-hidden="true".

color.description: Checked-state fill color. Generated by the `chip-builder` @each mixin over the $theme-colors map; applied to the `custom-chip` wrapper. Omit for the default gray fill.

themed.note: Sets the checked label background + border to the theme color. Generated, never a literal selector.

disabled.note: Set on the custom-chip-input, not the label.

root.note: Optionally add a chip-{color} modifier here.

children.note: type=checkbox or radio; visually hidden but focusable; must come before the label.
The visible pill. May contain a leading icon-* glyph and the chip text.
